f"""
WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.name AS assignee
  FROM {PUBLICATIONS}, UNNEST(assignee_harmonized) AS a
  WHERE grant_date BETWEEN {start} AND {end} AND {pred}
)
SELECT assignee, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total
FROM base
GROUP BY assignee
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT {topn}
""".strip

f"""

FROM {PUBLICATIONS}
WHERE grant_date BETWEEN {start} AND {end} AND {pred}
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
""".strip
